Overview

Robert Emilia Gerda of the Agatha family is the cousin of Duke Erwin Origin, Damon's older brother. According to Robert himself, his father had three sons, and after the death of Damon, he remained the last living of them. His branch of the genus he himself calls the "Origins of the Steps of Heaven", in contrast to the "Origins of the First Winter". Robert's ancestral domain is called the Sky Creature Gorge with two forts on the road from Leed to the First Winter, and Henry Horton (Forty Two), introducing him to Harmon, called him "Lord Robert Origin, Lord of the Heaven Creatures and Treasurer of Her Majesty". (Gates of Heaven; Forty-Two; Harmon Paula Roger) The gorge passed to the second branch of the family, when one of the dukes gave it to his younger brother.

Robert is the embodied northern coolness. The author presents him as a man who was a fatalist “at thirty, at twenty, and at ten.” His favorite answers are “Aha” and “Sometimes”, which he says on any news, from the battle won to the disaster.

In "Only One Star"

In August 1774, when Erwin became duke and started a war against Adrian (the Northern Flash), Robert had already served as treasurer of the First Winter for six years. (Northern Uprising) Erwin demanded money from him to go, and it turned out that the treasury was almost empty. Robert quickly calculated the costs in his mind: two battalions of the First Winter, three hundred kire, five gold each per month, plus vassal battalions. There were eleven thousand eight hundred Hilts during the month of the campaign. In this treasury lay one hundred and ninety Hilt in silver and eighty-six in gold, and of these fifty Hilt were already promised to the bishop and hospital of Gloria the Intercessor, and three hundred more to the masters for fortifying the bridge over the Fiddles of Heaven. When asked by Erwin if this meant that he had a hundred ephemera less than nothing, Robert shrugged his shoulders: “It happens.” The paltryness of the amount did not bother him: he believed that the treasurer’s business was to keep an accurate account and prevent theft, and the proceeds were in the hands of the Foremothers. In the campaign, Erwin made his cousin the chief military and financial manager of the army. Robert was involved in the crossing of the river Wise (led a detachment of two hundred kairs, swimming), accompanied Erwin to Windley and Doyle, handled barrels of gold received from the guilds, and the purchase of crossbows. At military councils, he usually offered cautious solutions - for example, to lure the enemy into the hills and shoot from the heights.

During the disaster at Pixie (December 2, 1774), Robert, according to eyewitness accounts, held bridges over the Mila, which saved a significant part of the army. Then the northern battalions took refuge in the catacombs of Labelin and at night defeated the army of Alexis Smile, who was celebrating the victory; Robert wrote Adrian a mocking letter about the "eight and a half thousand quail" - prisoners of the emperors. After this, he and Colonel General Statham led the army to Faunterra, to the rescue of Erwin, locked in the besieged palace of Faunterra. (Faunterra)

In "A Doll on the Throne" and "The Voice of Winter"

The death of brother Damon at the siege of the palace deeply shocked Robert. He asked Erwin for his retirement from military service: he needed to acquire an heir so that the branch would not be interrupted. Erwin, who became Lord Chancellor, secured the appointment of his cousin as imperial treasurer. At the same time, Erwin admitted that Robert was not able to fill the treasury, but vouched that he had not lost a single bag in six years. At the court of Minerva, Robert was an honest but tight-lipped steward: he gave the lady only a part of the necessary sums and followed the instructions of his cousin. On his instructions, Robert asked Minerva to confirm Craig Northwood as commander-in-chief of the spark forces, and in return was to allocate eighty thousand ephesas for repair of rail roads. Minerva signed, refusing the money, "out of sympathy" for him, and Robert left her a favor - one that will not go to the detriment of the House Origin. After the tax reform, Minerva left him as treasurer, calling him “a crystal-honored man”, and Robert decided to start a similar system in the First Winter. He returned the debt: he gave the lady a dozen kairs, which, according to her conditional signal, surrounded the guests in the execution room when she interrogated Alexis Smile about the death of Adrian. In February 1775, Robert, together with the Minister of Taxes Dreyfus Born, first brought Erwin the news of a peasant revolt in the uncontrolled part of the Southern Way; to Alanis's praise of his cousin, he only phlegmatically nodded: "Aha, it happens." In March, when on Palace Island after the death of Znaharka, the Origins got the Hand of Znaharka, Robert, initiated into the case, calmly offered to sell it: it was not part of the property of the Origins, and the money was needed by the treasury. (Healer's Hand) The proposal caused a storm: Desmond found it humiliating, and Lady Sophia almost cried. During the Trial of the Object, Robert, on the orders of Erwin, drew a sword, as if preparing to kill Kair Jemis if Gwenda did not heal his wound, it was a trick to force the girl to gather strength. Robert himself, like Jemis, could not put his hand on. Before the battle on the Holy Field, Erwin revealed his true plan only to his father and Robert; leaving the military council, Robert said to the indignant Iona: "It happens that it has to. (Standoff at the Holy Field) That and life.”

In the story "The Voice of Winter", Erwin, who received the family sword The Voice of Winter, asked Robert to teach him five family techniques of the Origins, which only Robert owned among the living. (Voice of Winter (Sword)) He showed the “Lightning of Agatha” — a blow that cuts the candle into three equal parts — but he refused to risk his life until he marries and leaves his son.

In "Yanmei Hunt" and "Humans and Gods"

Robert was part of Erwin's inner circle: together with Jemis Lilliday and Forty-Two, he studied the sacred texts of the Foremothers on the orders of the Duke in search of information about immortality. Remaining at Faunterra at Minerva with one battalion, he, on behalf of Erwin, said goodbye to her for his cousin and returned to her the Hand of the Znaharka as a dynasty property stolen from the Citadel. To the accusations of torture Ethan, he replied that torture is justified if required by the combat mission, and reminded of the mutilated Henry Horton (Forty-Two), the son of his friend and fellow soldier. Then Robert himself revealed to Minerva the order of his cousin: to hold the Palace Island, but with an overwhelming preponderance of the enemy, about one in six, to leave the city. He demanded a trial of Backfield for war crimes: he armed bandits and prisoners and mocked prisoners. (Croydon Beckfield) Nathaniel Robert suspected of having connections with the Puppeteer and once even tried to grab him, but then asked himself if the Healer's Hand could heal Forty-Two.

The Shadow of the Great Tree

Together with Henry Horton (Forty-Two), Robert brought the Crown Raven a Light Sphere, as if rolled out under his feet in the park, and undertook to pay for the balloons of Harmon Paula, but under strict supervision: "You are a fraud and a thief." (Radiant Sphere) When Adrian returned to the capital, Robert and Minerva took the entire treasury from Faunterra: 44% by bank transfer, the rest with them. Robert was ready to defend the hills with one battalion against four regiments, but Minerva, having transferred the capital to the First Winter, ordered him to load on ships and leave for Canaan with the treasury. He reluctantly counted her some money from the treasury with the note "Is issued at the whim of EIV Minerva." Even before, at the War Council at Faunterra, he had suggested that Desmond be asked to take Shayland alive to order Paul to lay down his arms, and although the treasurer's hand was trembling, promised to pay the gunmen for defense at Back; when there was no money left in the treasury, Minerva laid out a pack of appropriations, and Robert approved: "Aha... That's enough."

Two days after the departure of Vladyka Robert with the kairs, treasury and masters of Harmon sailed from the capital on Canaan and reached the port of Windley by sea, which was preparing for a siege. There he approved Harmon's balloon drawings and paid for the costs, explaining that by the First Winter the Puppeteer was coming from the west, and from the south Adrian and that by the Day of Descent any trifle could decide the outcome of the battle. In October 1775, Robert, with his battalion, treasury, and Sacred Objects, was the first of the Duke's family to return to the First Winter, where he was greeted with joyful cries: "Lord Robert is back!" Minerva entrusted him not only the Treasury, but also the Ministry of Finance: he drew up a budget and launched the printing of appropriations. At the feast, he sat among the "most enviable bachelors" and dreamed of an "honest, reliable wife of the Agatov family."

Back in Windley, Harmon Paula asked for permission to wear an old officer's camo with the coat of arms of the Origins, which he inherited from his cellmate, "Silent Jack", who died in the dungeon of the secret order of monks. (Walter Origin) Robert touched the brown spot on his back, asked if Jack had a left hand brush, examined the worn left cuff, and turned pale. Harmon said that Jack apparently killed himself to leave the executioners with nothing, and of the executioners he remembered only one - brother Ludwig from the burned monastery north of Labelin. Robert left the camsol to himself, promising Harmon another uniform with a coat of arms. Apparently, the Silent Jack was his father: Robert later stated that in the fall of 1765, Walter Origin went missing in the campaign in Windley, but in fact he was kidnapped and tortured by monks who obeyed the Queen of Darkwater.

On the offensive of the army of the Puppeteer for the First Winter, Richard warned his colleagues that Robert is the "worst stubborn in the First Winter", who knows no fear, no doubt and only says "Aha" to any trouble. He hoped that his cousin would delay the army for one or two weeks. However, Minerva, gathering forces to defend the capital of the North, transferred Robert's battalion to the First Winter, and in November the Chosen One army found both forts empty, with open gates and full cellars. Richard sadly said that his cousin had surrendered the family estate without a fight, and took it as a sign of agony at home. At the military council in the First Winter, when Navi in hysteria refused to give the generals new items, Robert only muttered: “It happens.” On December 2, in the battle for the First Winter, Robert survived: Erwin Iona, who woke up after being wounded, reported that "father and Robert are alive and well." (Battle for First Winter)

A few days later, in the First Winter, peace negotiations with Adrian began, and among the ambassadors came Lady in Darkness (Queen Madeline). (Lady in the Dark) As the guests climbed into the officer's salon, Robert removed Erwin and offered the old woman a hand. On the way, he deliberately asked her about the secret order, and then mentioned that he had been to one monastery before the campaign in Windley and remembered his good brother Ludwig - the same name that Harmon called him. The Queen replied with a laugh that Brother Ludwig did not remember him: if a “non-toppy” flew on his bed, he would have told her. Robert apologized, citing the fact that "repeatedly beat on the helmet." He put the Queen in a chair, crunched, and a minute later, Manson discovered that she had a broken neck.

Robert walked out into the middle of the cabin with his hands open:

“I did not carry out an attack, but a legal execution.”

He explained that in the northern land, the Duke's direct vassal was entitled to execute anyone who had encroached on the life of one of the Lords of the Origin. The attack took place in the fall of 1765, when his father was kidnapped by monks subordinate to the Queen of Darkwater. To the objections that safety was guaranteed, he replied that it was promised only to Adrian and his people, "there was no talk of a swamp witch." Minerva ordered the "Lord Treasurer" to surrender his weapons. Robert replied, “Sometimes...”, gave the belt with the sword, vowed to Agatha not to run and went under house arrest. Adrian admitted that Robert has settled personal accounts and has to answer in person.

In "Fantasies"

"Fantasies" the author calls possible options for the future. In the summer of 1776, Robert was serving the Minerva-appointed honorary "katorg". The monastery of Agatha the Radiant on the mountain above the First Winter is female, so the cell was taken to him in the attic of the guest house for pilgrims to the grotto of Kosuli; instead of the castle was his oath to Origin not to leave without the permission of the empress. (Roe Deer Grotto) From morning to night, he counted on scattered papers of the secretariat and ministries, how much a mile of track, the maintenance of a guard, kair or official, the training of an engineer or a doctor. The work was considered useless. Iona sensed a trick in it, and Erwin, checking the tables, concluded with a laugh that they prove: “the Yangmei dynasty is a useless parasite,” and Minerva, having received the papers, will burn them in the stove (“Let’s catch him”). He later prepared a financial analysis for Minerva.

One day at sunset, the ghost of Damon appeared to Robert with an arrow in his eye socket and reproached him that his brother could have come to Faunterra faster. Robert did not accept guilt and decided to order a large prayer service from the abbess for the repose of Damon and Desmond (more details - in the article by Damon Origin). At the celebration in honor of the twentieth anniversary of Minerva, he danced with the mistress.

In Closer to Further, Erwin handed him a letter from Earl Arrowback with a drawing. The Count lamented that his daughter Rose "was the victim of an insidious tempter", and, by all indications, offered Robert her hand; The "tempter" is Somerset Lighthart, who in "Annoying Little Things" by the will of the suzerain refused to be engaged to Rose and abandoned her. Erwin considered the offer "very good", Robert replied "Sometimes ...", promised to reflect and left a letter to himself, "wanting to re-read". Upon learning of Erwin’s affair with Minerva, Iona asked her brother in her heart, “Who’s next on your list? Robert?!

"Ad-ri-an!"

In November 1776, the treasurer "Lord Robert Origin" made calculations for the election program of Minerva: if every adult Polarian will pay to the treasury one agate a week, it will be enough for all its purposes. Minerva announced that she personally checked and confirmed these calculations. Minerve Erwin said that Robert "smothered Lady in the Dark" spontaneously and without his knowledge, but it turned out to be "very successful": for Mireille Nan-Claire, "mother's body is the best gift." In the comic "section" of the Crown Lands played for Bird Without Flesh, Erwin gave to Robert Orwell. Under the power-sharing agreement, if Erwin and Minerva have a common child, the new shogun will be the heir to Iona or Robert. Earl Arrowback married his daughter Rose to Robert. According to Erwin, Robert "dreams of procreation", and Robert and Rose "liked each other from the first meeting" and will soon get engaged. Erwin asked Francis-Ilian to conduct the ceremony, and he willingly agreed.

Personality and Appearance

Robert is a bearded, broad-shouldered, scarred kair. His equanimity came into the proverb: according to Richard, this is the “worst stubborn in the First Winter”, who knows neither fear nor doubt, and the Minerva court considered him “the calmest of the northerners”. He is honest to pedantry and not strong in finance. He is devoted to Erwin and House Origin, while ruthless - for example, indifferent to the torture of Ethan. Revenge for his father, Robert performed with the same cold detail with which he kept accounts. His silly tone amused the Lady in Darkness, who mistook him for a "naive warrior", although Robert, imitating Erwin, tried to scout out the secret of the order.

Trivia

  • Lady Karen in the collectible edition of Arrow, Coin, Spark wondered why there was no Robert at a meeting at Desmond's bedside in August 1774, and asked him himself. (Arrow, Coin, Spark (Collector's Edition)) Robert replied that he was in the same room with Lilliday, Statham and others, hugged his cousin and, after listening to the story of the exploit, said, "It happens." His description in "Only One Star" he, according to her, pleased. Manson also refers to “our treasurer” in his remarks: “it happens.”
  • Erwin learned fencing from Robert and in "The Shadow of the Great Tree" in battle takes a defensive stance, "just like Robert taught."
  • Sophia's note from the voyage, warning against Queen Madeline and her order, Minerva handed over to Robert, and he answered her with his "Aha".

Appearances

  • "One Star Only": first appearance in the First Winter in August 1774; trek south; Pixy and Labelin.
  • “A Doll on the Throne”, “The Voice of Winter”, “Yanmei Hunt”, “Those We Forgive”, “Humans and Gods”, “The Shadow of the Great Tree”, “Fantasies” (“Let’s catch him”, “Closer — further”, “Ad-ri-an!”).
